claims.sentence: Recent systems retrieve the cited work, locate candidate evidence and assign a verdict, typically including a partial-support category \citep{haan2025semanticcite,mocan2026refverifier,sadeghi2026deepsciverify,lee2026reflens,li2026bibagent}.
claims.claim: RefLens retrieves the cited work, locates candidate evidence and assigns a verdict that includes a partial-support category.
claims.excerpt: a Crawler agent then automatically downloads the original source PDFs from online academic databases ... based on a three-axis evaluation model: intent (Cohan et al. 2019), validity (Zhang and Abernethy 2024), and user-defined importance. ... instructing it to identify and extract verbatim the most relevant text spans that support or contradict the claim.
claims.location: Method: RefLens, Preprocessing and Hierarchical Verification (pp. 41625-41626)
claims.note: Retrieval (Crawler) and evidence location (verbatim span extraction) are stated, and a 'validity' judgement is made. But the paper does not give a verdict label set and mentions no partial-support category. Suggested rewording: 'Recent systems retrieve the cited work or take it as input, locate candidate evidence and assign a verdict; some add a partial-support category \citep{haan2025semanticcite,mocan2026refverifier}.' (cite all five for the first clause, only these two for the partial-support clause).
